text:
Tara PM: Quick sync — we need to lock the Optimize toolkit scope for the next release. Customers keep asking for concrete cost/latency recommendations and eval-triggered alerts. I'm proposing a tight MVP: per-route batching recommendations, a simple prefix/KV caching suggestion UI, and a 'what-to-quantize' checklist. Thoughts on what must ship vs stretch?

Liam Eng: +1 on MVP. Practical order: (1) batching hints (model+seq stats -> suggested batch size + expected latency/cost delta), (2) caching suggestions (detect repeated prefixes + hit-rate est.), (3) quantization guidance as a follow-up — needs more infra to validate.

Anita ML: For eval-triggered alerts we should tie to held-out prompt sets and metrics (PPL drift, token-level divergence, quality-score drop). Suggest launch criteria: - alerting when delta > X% for 3/5 evals, - automated snapshot + link to failing examples, - severity mapping (info/warn/critical).

Marco SRE: Keep rollout / kill-switch simple for MVP. Need: feature-flag per-customer, sampling for compute-heavy analysis, and a cost-estimate API so ops can see potential GPU delta before recommendations apply. Also, make sure recommendations are advisory by default (opt-in).

Emily PMM: Customers who asked (fintech and search startups) want a one-click migration guide + preset profiles (latency-sensitive / cost-saving / balanced). Console + CLI access is required. Also requests: exportable report (PDF/CSV) for vendor procurement. :thumbsup:

Tara PM: Proposed concrete launch checklist (MVP):
- batching hints UI + per-route recommended batch size (owner: Liam)
- caching suggestions with estimated hit-rate and token savings (owner: Marco)
- simple quantization checklist content (owner: Anita)
- eval-triggered alerts wired to console + email with sample examples (owner: Anita)
- feature flags + per-customer opt-in (owner: Marco)
- docs + migration guide + 2 customer pre-release signups (owner: Emily)

Tara PM: Example API response we want from the recommendation engine:
```json
{
  "route": "/chat/gpt-like",
  "recommended_batch_size": 8,
  "expected_p99_latency_ms": "+40ms",
  "estimated_token_savings_pct": "12%",
  "confidence": "medium"
}
```

Liam Eng: MVP dev estimate: ~5 dev-weeks for batching + telemetry hooks, 3 weeks for caching detector, 2 weeks for recommendation UI. Add 2 weeks for testing/rollout automation.

Anita ML: For alert thresholds I'll draft a default config. Proposal: alerts trigger when quality drop > 5% over baseline on 3 consecutive runs. We should let customers adjust sensitivity.

Marco SRE: I'll add cost-estimate RPC and the FF (feature-flag) wiring. Can we make recommendation evaluation async with sampled sync path? reduces latency risk.

Emily PMM: I'll curate 2 pilot customers (one search, one marketplace). Will draft PRD for the migration guide.

Tara PM: OK — next steps: owners implement their parts and post a short status update in #product next Monday. Emily will recruit pilots this week. Anita, can you drop the default alert config by EOD Friday? @Anita ML

sprint-bot: Created ticket PROD-OPT-482: "Optimize toolkit MVP — batching + caching + alerting" and assigned to owners listed.
